text: As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates a transit service on Underhill Drive, City Council approval of this report is required. Transportation Services is requesting approval to prohibit northbound and southbound U-turn movements at all times on Underhill Drive, between Cassandra Boulevard and Doonaree Drive.

City Council on June 15 and 16, 2022, adopted the following: 1. City Council prohibit northbound and southbound U-turn movements at all times on Underhill Drive, between Cassandra Boulevard and Doonaree Drive.
